messages:
maya: Heads-up — thinking about a small console tile that shows a per-invocation 'cache-adjusted token cost' sparkline for each route. Goal: make unit-econ visible in near real-time (net tokens after KV/prefetch credits). Want to agree on attribution rules before I mock UI.

jon: Love the idea. Main Q: how do we attribute shared prefetched credits to individual invocations? Per-invocation prorating will be noisy for high-throughput routes. :thinking:

sam: Two quick options: (1) amortize prefetch across the session and attach to first N invocations, or (2) prorate by token-length of each invocation in the cost window. Both have tradeoffs.

ashley: Also add model-variant delta line (e.g., quantized vs fp16) so PMs can see impact of switching variants. Can we reuse the existing per-call sparkline infra? @jon

jon: We already emit these per-invocation metrics: tokens_billed, tokens_saved_kv_cache, tokens_saved_prefetch. Prefetch credits currently live at route/session level and are amortized offline. SQL prototype for net tokens: ```sql
SELECT invocation_id, tokens_billed - tokens_saved_kv_cache - tokens_saved_prefetch AS net_tokens
FROM invocations
WHERE ts >= :start AND route = :route_id;
```
If we expose net_tokens in the rollup API we can drive the sparkline without UI-side math.

maya: Perfect. UX question: should tile default to per-route or per-model? My vote: default per-route, with a breakdown by model-variant on hover/expand.

sam: Per-route default sounds right. Add a toggle: "amortize prefetch across session" vs "assign to first N invocations" so teams can pick what matches their billing model.

ashley: Alerting ask: when net-token unit cost for a route increases >20% vs baseline for X minutes, surface a cost-regression marker tied to rollout canaries and link to the rollout ID. :warning:

jon: Implementation notes: for heavy routes we need sampled rollups. Proposal: compute net_tokens at 1s granularity in the stream, then pre-aggregate to 1m windows. Sketch of rollup config: ```json
{
  "rollup_window_sec": 60,
  "metrics": ["sum(net_tokens)", "p50(net_tokens)", "count_invocations"]
}
```
We can support a query param ?amortize_prefetch=boolean to switch attribution in the API.

ci-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry/rollups will ship Tue 03:00 UTC (infra/telemetry).

maya: OK — follow-ups: @jon add rollup endpoint and query flag, @sam produce a compact mock for the new tile, @ashley define alert thresholds & the baseline window. I will draft the console spec and wireframe tomorrow.

jon: One more nit — make sure tenant-level quotas/alerts still correlate to gross tokens (before credits) for quota enforcement; net_tokens only used for econ surfaces.

maya: Yep, keep quotas on gross tokens. Net tokens only for visibility and cost alerts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
